value.rationale: This resolves the complete natural zero-field two-spin tunneling component graph of the 60-site fullerene, a physically motivated benchmark already used in quantum annealing. The ten Q6 sectors and single giant component have sharply different spectral radii, which rigorously singles out the leading weak-field selected state; the result is not a routine restatement of the known 16000 state count.
